name: mirrored-confrontation-reveal-level-3-champion-draws-into-memory-and-recovers
notes: Mirrored Confrontation: player 1 reveals their level 3 champion (Lorraine, Crux Knight) and draws a card into memory and recovers 2; player 2 declines. The effect used to never run.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Mirrored Confrontation's effect was generated as an $enterAbilities entry, but it is an Action that never enters the field, so activating it only paid its cost and sent it to the graveyard: the effect never ran. Fix: OnCardActivated() runs an Action's enter ability as its resolution effect when the card has no activation ability of its own.
